scope: All 72 unprotected official-catalogue entries; all 74 primary pages were read; protected Multi Hot 5 and Foxy Hot 20 were not modified.
sourcePolicy: Primary public pages and already observed public DEMO help only. No private endpoints or provider source-code extraction.
interpretationPolicy: An advertised feature is not proof of implementation, probability equivalence, certified RTP or production readiness. Source conflicts are retained.

games.title: PopX
publicRulesSummary: A 6-column, 5-row board has 11 symbol types. Groups of at least eight identical symbols anywhere win and disappear; refill cascades increase the multiplier. A nonwinning refill ends the round.
The public page describes a shared multiplayer board. This independent implementation does not establish synchronized multiplayer equivalence.

games.title: Mine Island2
publicRulesSummary: Ten multiplier steps and three risk modes are specified. A boost increases remaining awards by 1.5x–2x, and a portal can rescue a fall. The advertised hard-mode maximum is 10000x.

games.title: New Era of JetX
publicRulesSummary: The page lists four concurrent bets, auto-play and auto-cash-out, live round history and player data.

games.title: BalloonX
publicRulesSummary: Collect before the growing balloon bursts. Four concurrent bets are listed.

games.title: Plinko X Classic
publicRulesSummary: The observed demo has 16 peg rows and 17 buckets. Pink, orange and fire balls carry 1x, 5x and 10x factors. The advertised maximum is 10000x.
The implementation uses server-selected colors and independent 995/4/1 weights; neither the weights nor the selection process are claimed as provider probabilities.
sourceConflicts: Marketing describes player-selected stake factors. The separately observed demo presents a static color legend and a 10000x maximum without an observed color selector.

games.title: Propel X
publicRulesSummary: The plane passes three visual danger zones. Two concurrent bets and automatic cash-out are listed. The advertised maximum is 1000000x.

games.title: World Champion X
publicRulesSummary: Collect before the football attacker is tackled. Both click-and-collect and press-and-hold controls are listed.

games.title: Power of Tiger
publicRulesSummary: Five active paylines are specified. A full board of one symbol or wins on all five lines activates a 5x, 10x, 15x or 20x multiplier.
The random respin feature locks the selected symbol and wilds; it ends after no new locks or a full board. The feature multiplier applies to a full board.

games.title: Multi Fruits Charging Wilds
publicRulesSummary: A nonwinning wild stays in place and increases its multiplier by one each new spin. Five fixed paylines are listed.

games.title: Gems Crown Charging Wilds
publicRulesSummary: Each nonwinning crown wild persists and increases its multiplier independently. A contributing wild multiplies its win and is removed; unused wilds continue charging. Five lines are listed.

games.title: Gates of Merlyn
publicRulesSummary: Four or more scatters trigger 15 free spins. Three or more scatters within the bonus add five spins. Contributing multipliers accumulate across the bonus.
Multiplier symbols combine across the tumble sequence. A magic symbol can remove another symbol after a nonwinning board.

games.title: Chicken Ways
publicRulesSummary: Each step offers two or three risk choices. Difficulty can change at individual steps. The advertised maximum is 10000x.

games.title: Dice Jungle
publicRulesSummary: The page lists a 5x3 dice grid, a synchronized horizontal multiplier reel, wilds, scatters and hold-and-spin. The complete payout rules are absent.

games.title: Multi Hot 5 Wild
publicRulesSummary: Three reels and three rows with five fixed lines. Wild substitutes on three-symbol left-to-right wins; the left multiplier reel offers 1x–5x. X2 is advertised.

The observed Rules paytable contains nine regular symbols and a separate Wild award. At total stake 0.05 DMO over five lines, prizes correspond to line multipliers 75, 50, 25, 15, 15, 5, 5, 5, 5 and Wild 100.
sourceConflicts: The observed all-wild prize and a possible 5x multiplier permit a 500x independent full-board bound; the help states 375x. Provider restrictions or coupling are unverified.

games.title: Cheesy Road
publicRulesSummary: Easy, medium and difficult directions can be chosen at each step, followed by another jump or cash-out. The advertised maximum is 10000x.

games.title: Fortune Catch
publicRulesSummary: The multiplier increases after successful player picks, not merely with elapsed time. A wrong pick can end the round. Eight multipliers are listed.

games.title: Multi Hot 20
publicRulesSummary: Three rows and five reels, an extra 1x–5x multiplier and red/black X2 are described. The fixed-line count is inconsistent on this page.
sourceConflicts: The game is titled Multi Hot 20, but its feature list states 100 fixed paylines; this is not reliable evidence to replace the 20-line configuration.

games.title: Cheesy Road Classic
publicRulesSummary: Choose whether to advance toward another multiplier or collect before a trap. Three difficulty levels are advertised.

games.title: Multi Hot 10
publicRulesSummary: Three rows and five reels with ten fixed lines, a 1x–5x multiplier and red/black X2.

games.title: Multi Hot 40
publicRulesSummary: Four rows and five reels with 40 fixed lines, an extra multiplier and X2. The text does not enumerate the multiplier values.

games.title: Coins Of Atlantis
publicRulesSummary: Wilds on reels two through four expand when used in a win. Five or more coins trigger a locked-coin respin feature.
New coins reset the three-respin allowance. Filling the board doubles the feature total.

games.title: Multi Hot 100
publicRulesSummary: Four rows and five reels with 100 fixed lines and a 1x–5x multiplier. Observed help permits red/black doubling or collecting a held win.

games.title: Multi Hot Wild Ways
publicRulesSummary: The page specifies 27 ways and wild substitution across successive reels from the left. The multiplier reel applies to the total spin win.

games.title: Bottle Mania
publicRulesSummary: Choose a bottle with its own color and maximum; collect before it bursts. The advertised overall maximum is 50000x.

games.title: Multi Hot 5 Burn Wilds
publicRulesSummary: Three rows and five reels, five lines, and wilds restricted to reels two through four. A contributing wild fills its reel vertically.
The total win receives a 1x–5x multiplier; X2 is also advertised.

games.title: Chicken Highway
publicRulesSummary: Three starting difficulty levels are described. The advertised maximum is 10000x.

games.title: Multi Hot 5 Deluxe
publicRulesSummary: The specifications explicitly state three reels, three rows and five fixed lines.

games.title: CarX
publicRulesSummary: Separate cash-out and end-range bets are described; the present independent cash-out model does not implement the range bet.

games.title: Cai Balao Cappadocia
publicRulesSummary: The page describes separate three-reel slot and crash modes. Matching balloons can start a flight bonus. Slot and crash maximums are 1000x and 25000x.

games.title: Multi Hot Wheel
publicRulesSummary: The wheel has 50 sectors. Bets select multiplier fields; only a matching field wins. A designated field starts the bonus with a possible 1000x award.

games.title: Jingle Bell Bonanza
publicRulesSummary: Wilds on reels two through four expand when contributing to a win. Scatters and an extra multiplier up to 5x are listed.

games.title: Multi Hot 5 Super Wilds
publicRulesSummary: The public page specifies five reels, three rows and five fixed lines, plus a wild, extra multiplier and X2.

games.title: Safari Simba
publicRulesSummary: The specifications state three reels, three rows and five lines. The description also advertises expanding wilds and free spins.

games.title: Mine Island
publicRulesSummary: A grid-based pick game reveals multipliers while avoiding mines. The page does not specify exact dimensions or award probabilities.

games.title: Multi Hot Ways
sourceConflicts: The page describes Burning Ice 40 and its specifications instead of the catalogued title.

games.title: Habesha Fortune 5
publicRulesSummary: Three reels and a 3x3 board are explicitly described. The complete line chart and award schedule are not specified.

games.title: 4 Bonuses Bonanza
publicRulesSummary: A pegboard ball-drop game includes variable volatility and bonus rounds; precise board dimensions and bonus rules are not supplied.

games.title: Burning Ice
publicRulesSummary: Five reels, three rows and five paylines are specified. Wild and scatter features are advertised.

games.title: Wheel Of Destiny
publicRulesSummary: A spinning-wheel game with a bonus feature advertises a maximum of 1200x.

games.title: Wild Multi Stars
publicRulesSummary: Five reels, wild multipliers and stacked symbols are described; full mechanics are not supplied.

games.title: Crash Duel
publicRulesSummary: Players select a side in a short competitive round. The detailed outcome and settlement rules are not published on this page.

games.title: Genie's Bonanza
sourceConflicts: The introduction calls this a six-reel game while its specifications state five reels and six rows.

games.title: Bonus Time
publicRulesSummary: The page lists a seven-segment wheel, selectable wager segments and three bonus types: Boost, Double and Chest.

games.title: Farm's Fortune
publicRulesSummary: The farmer wild appears on reels two through four and expands when part of a win. Scatters, an extra multiplier up to 5x and gamble are listed.

games.title: Mad Slot
publicRulesSummary: Five reels, three rows and 20 lines are specified. Wilds, cascades, free spins and bonus purchase are advertised.

games.title: AviaStar
sourceConflicts: The page describes JetX3. The relationship to the catalogued AviaStar demo has not been independently verified.

games.title: Tower X
publicRulesSummary: The multiplier increases as the tower adds levels. Collect before the tower collapses.

games.title: Hot Samba
sourceConflicts: The introduction specifies five reels and 20 lines; its specifications instead state three reels, three rows and five lines.

games.title: Wilds and Gods
publicRulesSummary: Five reels with expanding wilds, free spins and bonus purchase are described.

games.title: Bao Slot 5X
publicRulesSummary: A 3x3 grid and a double-or-nothing gamble feature are described.

games.title: Jungle Sisters
publicRulesSummary: Expanding wilds, scatter-triggered free spins and bonus purchase are described.

games.title: Boka Jamba 10
publicRulesSummary: Wild and scatter features are described, but exact geometry and the line chart are absent.

games.title: Jungle Sisters Deluxe
publicRulesSummary: Twenty fixed lines and a random multiplier reel are specified. Seven or more scatters trigger free spins; the page does not give their count.

games.title: Dragon's Code
publicRulesSummary: Four matching symbols on the first reel plus a wild elsewhere can start the respin feature. A golden egg can instead fill the first reel with dragons.
The feature collects symbols until no additional symbols arrive, then totals the award.

games.title: Dracula's Fortune
publicRulesSummary: Five reels with wilds and scatter-triggered free spins are described.

games.title: Book of Futuria
publicRulesSummary: Five reels and scatter-triggered free spins are described. A randomly chosen symbol expands in the bonus.

games.title: Book of Bonanza
publicRulesSummary: Books act as wilds and scatters; the bonus uses free spins and expanding symbols. The page omits the numeric trigger and spin count.

games.title: Sugar Fiesta
publicRulesSummary: Three fixed paylines and a multiplier reel with a maximum factor of five are specified.

games.title: Vampires
publicRulesSummary: Five reels, expanding symbols and scatter-triggered free spins are described.

games.title: Burning Ice 10
publicRulesSummary: Five reels and ten paylines with wild substitution and scatter awards are specified.

games.title: Roll X
publicRulesSummary: Players choose a multiplier before spinning a wheel and win on its green area. The advertised maximum is 30x.

games.title: Double X
sourceConflicts: The paragraph switches from Double X to Slicer X; the exact demo rules still need confirmation.

games.title: Samurai
sourceConflicts: The detailed specification names Samurai Delux and includes optional features; applicability to the catalogued Samurai demo needs confirmation.
